title: Guard terminal retention against provider observation map-key mismatches
outcome: Terminal retention refuses persisted provider rows whose actual observation key differs from their execution identity before changing an observation or retaining a native completion.
acceptance: With an observation stored under a key different from its execution identity, ordinary artifact settlement leaves the unrelated keyed row unchanged and native settlement cannot retain a completion using that mismatched row.
A deterministic persistence round trip exercises both branches and retains the positive case for an exact observation identity.
